text: Aurora Times reports that the River bend samples show elevated nitrate levels and officials warn residents to avoid drawing water until Saturday.

Climate Briefing summarizes: River bend nitrate levels spike after upstream runoff according to the water authority report, but filtration upgrades are scheduled.

Local Radio bulletin says the water authority will flush mains overnight and expects nitrate levels to settle by Saturday morning.
@RiverWatch update: crews flushing mains tonight, nitrate alert likely lifted Saturday per officials.

Weekend wrap: River nitrate scare fades as Saturday tests confirm safe levels; officials say filtration upgrades start Monday.
